label: SYNTHETIC AUDIO — computer voices, not a real consultation
about: Windows text-to-speech reading a scripted consultation about a fictional child (the synthetic patient of npm run demo:hero). No person was recorded. The text below is the script, for documentation and tests; the application shows only what the speech model transcribes from the audio.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Good morning. What brings you in today?

utterances.speaker: parent
utterances.text: My daughter has had a fever for three days and a mild cough.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Has she had any breathing difficulty or wheezing?

utterances.speaker: parent
utterances.text: A little wheezing at night. She had a similar chest infection two months ago.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Is she taking any medicines at the moment?

utterances.speaker: parent
utterances.text: She uses her salbutamol inhaler when she wheezes.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Does she have any allergies to medicines?

utterances.speaker: parent
utterances.text: Yes, she gets a rash with amoxicillin.
